experiment.removal: W_k = W_instruct - U[:, :k] S[:k] Vt[:k] (rank-k truncation of the delta)
experiment.twin_proxy: W_twin - W_instruct; twin_capture is the share of the twin delta inside the removed U_k / V_k subspace (static proxy, not a refusal measurement)

selection.rule: max twin_capture (left+right) subject to weight_norm_ratio >= floor

caveats: removal_measured is false: nothing here observes what the model answers.
The alignment delta also carries instruction-following, so a capability cost is expected and is NOT measured by this experiment.

twin_capture reads a public abliterated checkpoint as a weight-space proxy for the refusal-consistent component; it is not a refusal measurement, and the twin delta also contains that checkpoint's own fine-tuning and quantization.
Singular directions are statistical (largest delta energy), not causal; a direction being removed first does not make it a refusal direction.
The curve is the result. Any k below is a displayed point on it, not a behaviourally validated winner.
